title: Gradient-estimator design overcomes trainability barriers in neural-network-based variational optimization
abstract: arXiv:2609.22342v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Neural networks provide expressive representations for scientific computing. However, even sufficiently expressive networks can suffer training failure in weak-gradient regimes, limiting their practical use in quantum many-body physics and ab initio quantum chemistry. Here we derive an unbiased direct gradient estimator and introduce the adaptive minimum-variance phase (AMVP) estimator for neural-network variational optimization. By improving the signal-to-noise ratio of weak gradients, these methods enable reliable scientific calculations where training previously failed, while substantially reducing computational cost. The framework enables compact networks to outperform larger and fine-tuned default standard-estimator models with over an order of magnitude less GPU time on correlated flux models, and ultimately exceed the density matrix renormalization group (DMRG) accuracy. translated_title: 梯度估计器设计克服了基于神经网络的变分优化中的可训练性障碍
translated_abstract: 神经网络为科学计算提供了富有表现力的表示方法。然而，即使是具有充分表达能力的网络，在弱梯度区间也可能出现训练失败，这限制了它们在量子多体物理和从头算量子化学中的实际应用。在此，我们推导了一个无偏直接梯度估计器，并为神经网络变分优化引入了自适应最小方差相位（AMVP）估计器。通过提高弱梯度的信噪比，这些方法使得在以往训练失败的情形下也能进行可靠的科学计算，同时大幅降低了计算成本。该框架使紧凑的网络能够在关联通量模型上以超过一个数量级更少的GPU时间，超越更大且经过微调的默认标准估计器模型，并最终超越密度矩阵重正化群（DMRG）的精度。该方法还在N₂键断裂计算中达到了化学精度。
tldr: 该论文提出无偏直接梯度估计器和自适应最小方差相位（AMVP）估计器，通过提升弱梯度信噪比克服了神经网络变分优化的训练失败问题，以更少的计算成本实现了超越DMRG精度和化学精度的量子多体与量子化学计算。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes an unbiased direct gradient estimator and an adaptive minimum-variance phase (AMVP) estimator that overcome trainability barriers in neural-network variational optimization by improving the signal-to-noise ratio of weak gradients, enabling reliable quantum many-body and quantum chemistry calculations—including surpassing DMRG accuracy and achieving chemical accuracy—at substantially reduced computational cost.
